description: This file defines the ArticlesController class in an ASP.NET Core application, handling HTTP requests related to articles such as listing, retrieving, creating, editing, and deleting articles. It utilizes MediatR for command dispatching and implements authorization for modification actions.

classes.name: ArticlesController
classes.description: Controller handling article-related HTTP endpoints, using dependency injection for IMediator, with actions for retrieving, creating, editing, and deleting articles.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET /articles, retrieves a list of articles possibly filtered by tag, author, favorited, limit, and offset.

methods.name: GetFeed
methods.description: Handles GET /articles/feed, retrieves a feed of articles based on user's feed criteria.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET /articles/{slug}, retrieves detailed information about a specific article.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST /articles, creates a new article, requires authorization.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Handles PUT /articles/{slug}, edits an existing article, requires authorization.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE /articles/{slug}, deletes an article, requires authorization.
